title: Wayfarer's Toolkit
description: GM tools for dnd5e: overland hex travel with off-road encounter rolls, flight routes with fares paid from a party purse (players can book flights too, with an optional departure sound), a session-start helper, WoW-style vendor trash loot, a riding feat, and an optional three-coin economy (copper, silver, gold at 100 to 1). Campaign content stays in your world; the module supplies the logic.
